_column_contract: Summit's cover box runs Current | Last(=Previous, 2024 sheet) | Cumulative — the REVERSE of the parsed cities' sheet. All three columns are captured VERBATIM and LABELLED here; the builder promotes one per the rule documented in CLAUDE.md. "" = the cell was EMPTY (or a slashed-zero / dash nil mark) on the form; null = a value is present but ILLEGIBLE and was never guessed.

Surname on this sheet reads BROCK (the 1081 sheet is ambiguous B-L/R). CALIBRATION CASE for the column trap: Current Report is all $0.00 while Last Report and Cumulative carry the money — a Millcreek-order parser taking the second-to-last token would read the Last Report column.

_meta_itemized.page_gates: PAGE POSITION IS NOT A CLASSIFIER on this filing: p2 is the ITEMIZED EXPENSE REPORT and p3 the ITEMIZED CONTRIBUTION REPORT. p2 prints 'Total amount of expenditures $2,662.89'; its 6 real rows sum to 2,662.89 to the cent and equal the cover. p3 prints TWO boxes, '>$50 $2,592.89' and '<=$50 $70.00', which sum to the module's stated contribution figure of 2,662.89; the 3 real rows reproduce BOTH boxes exactly (Walter Brock 2,592.89 = the >$50 box; the two '$50 or less donor' rows 50.00 + 20.00 = the <=$50 box), so this filing has NO structural residual at all. On both pages the printed SPECIMEN row is highlighted in YELLOW by the county's own copy and is dropped; the arithmetic is the proof - including them gives 3,174.89 on p2 and 3,097.89 on p3.

_meta_itemized.notes: Walter Brock, County Recorder/Surveyor, 2014 Post-Election; split50 form, typed ledgers on a scanned sheet, county RECEIVED stamps of Nov 2014 on both schedule pages. GRAIN: this report is unambiguously CUMULATIVE and needs no ruling - the cover's Current Report column is $0.00 on every row while Last Report and Cumulative Totals both carry the figures, i.e. the filer reported no new activity after his pre-election report, and the two ledgers sum to those cumulative figures. SOURCE PROPERTIES: (1) PAGE ORDER IS REVERSED against the module's usual layout - expenses on p2, contributions on p3 (the 1059 / 23013 / 24377 precedent, seen again here). (2) The county's published copy has the two printed SPECIMEN rows HIGHLIGHTED IN YELLOW on both pages - the clearest form yet of the marking this wave has seen struck in pen elsewhere; they are still not transactions and the printed totals close only without them. Note this copy dates the expense specimen 8/25/14 (a 2014-year variant), not the 8/25/10 seen on other copies. (3) A SOURCE PROPERTY THE BRIEF DID NOT LIST: the filer ITEMIZED HIS <=$50 AGGREGATE as two anonymised rows literally named '$50 or less donor', dated and with amounts ($50.00 on 8/14/14 and $20.00 on 8/25/14) but with the Mailing Address and Zipcode cells deliberately empty. They are printed transaction lines and they close the $70.00 box to the cent, so they are transcribed as rows with the placeholder name verbatim - they are anonymity BY THE FORM's design, not missing data, and they must never be read as a named donor. (4) $2,592.89 of the $2,662.89 raised - the entire >$50 side - is the CANDIDATE's own money, itemized as a donor row in his own name; the campaign raised and spent the same amount and closed at zero. (5) An expenditure date cell is printed '8//2014' with NO DAY; under the strict-date gate it is stored BLANK with needs_review=1 and the verbatim in the row note, never repaired from context (its neighbours are 7/30 and 8/4). (6) Addresses are printed in full and unredacted; only city/state are retained per the privacy contract. (7) The $781.03 'Write-in Fee' paid to Summit County is the same figure other 2014 Summit filers record as their 'Filing Fee' (e.g. Trussell 1058/1250) - the county's 2014 county-office fee. GEOMETRY: MEASURED on both pages. p2 detects a clean 37-band grid AND five column rules, so its boxes are fully measured; p3 detects the same clean grid but NO column rules, so the record supplies the table's own x/w (8.8 / 81.8, measured off the page) while the y bands stay measured. Verified by render-back: p2 band 3 resolves to '7/30/14 Summit County / GIS GRAMA Request / $16.50' and band 8 to '8/12/14 Karsten Moench / Web Site Creation / $600.00'; p3 band 4 to '8/14/14 $50 or less donor / $50.00' and band 6 to '8/11/14 Walter Brock / PO Box 876, Coalville, UT / 84017 / $2,592.89'.
